Simulate trees near target values of gamma and Colless

Source: R/target.R
sim_tree_target.Rd

Draws trees whose gamma statistic and normalized Colless index (see tree_shape()) fall within a tolerance of target values. The parameters beta and c whose mean statistics equal the targets are found with calibrate_shape() and shape_params(). Topologies are then drawn with rtopology_beta() and kept if their Colless index is within tol of the target, interval sets are drawn with intervals_lineage_rate() and kept if their gamma is within tol of the target, and the kept topologies and interval sets are combined with assign_ages(). Because the topology and the intervals are independent, rejecting them separately gives the same distribution of trees as rejecting whole trees on both statistics, with a much higher acceptance rate. Random numbers are used in a different order than in sim_tree_shape(), so the same seed does not give the same trees as that function.

Usage

sim_tree_target(
  n,
  gamma,
  colless,
  nsim = 1,
  tol = 0.5,
  calibration = NULL,
  reps = 200,
  max_tries = 1000 * nsim,
  root_age = 1
)

Arguments

n

Number of tips, a single integer of at least 2.

gamma, colless

Target gamma statistic and normalized Colless index (single values).

nsim

Number of trees.

tol

Tolerance around the targets: one value for both statistics, or two values for gamma and Colless, in this order.

calibration

Output of calibrate_shape() for the same n; if NULL, it is computed with reps draws per value.

reps

Passed to calibrate_shape() when calibration is NULL.

max_tries

Maximum number of topologies, and of interval sets, drawn.

root_age

Age of the root.

Value

With nsim = 1, a phylo object; otherwise a multiPhylo object (also when fewer trees than nsim are found). Attributes: shape (realized gamma and Colless of each tree), params (beta and c used) and acceptance (proportion of topologies and of interval sets kept). If fewer than nsim trees are found within max_tries, the trees found are returned with a warning.

Examples

set.seed(1)
cal <- calibrate_shape(50, reps = 50)
trees <- sim_tree_target(50, gamma = -1, colless = 0.5, nsim = 5,
                         calibration = cal)
attr(trees, "shape")
#>        gamma    colless
#> 1 -0.5955608 0.08390851
#> 2 -1.0764385 0.38390851
#> 3 -0.9091632 0.02390851
#> 4 -0.9009388 0.12390851
#> 5 -1.2630195 0.44390851
